name: Tuna
role: Cheapest medium, most predictable. Easy team shooting.
habit: Schools of 2-4 that hold formation (side-by-side arc or diagonal echelon). Always enters and leaves at corners.
status: designed, not in game yet (game v7 has the older medium set)

routes.name: Corner run
routes.purpose: Corner to opposite corner as a block.

routes.name: Crisscross
routes.purpose: Two schools at once, mirrored, crossing in an X. Best used as the release right after a Shark leaves.

routes.name: Corner swing
routes.purpose: Corner to the neighbouring corner in an arch; flips to open up or down away from the Shark.

routes.name: Corner hook
routes.purpose: Stays on one side, corner to corner. The Tuna option while a Shark splits the screen.
